patch.value: Recognize third-party publish wrappers (semantic-release, np, release-it, lerna publish, changeset publish) in the canonical attestation auditor

CodeRabbit on pm-ops#162 noted that npm-installed publish wrappers invoke npm publish from dependency source outside the tracked repository. isExecutableSource covers tracked wrappers only. Track recognition and fail-closed provenance auditing for semantic-release, np, release-it, lerna publish, and changeset publish; implementation is out of scope for the braces dependency PR.

Recognize semantic-release, np, release-it, lerna publish, and changeset publish in package scripts and workflow run steps.; Fail closed when wrapper provenance cannot be certified, without executing or publishing anything.; Add real scratch repository regressions for each wrapper, plus non-publish lerna and changeset controls and tracked-wrapper coverage.; Document the dependency-source boundary and wrapper diagnostics; retain existing attestation regressions and unchanged coverage thresholds.

Create a scratch repository with a package script or release workflow invoking each npm-installed wrapper; omit direct npm publish and tracked wrapper source; run the canonical attestation auditor and inspect whether it recognizes a publish path or incorrectly reports no publish commands.
Known dependency publish wrappers are recognized and unresolved provenance is refused with actionable diagnostics.
Tracked executable source is audited, but npm-installed publish wrappers can hide the publish path from source scanning.
